policy: An author's stated request about how their work is used is honoured even when the CC0 dedication would legally permit more. KayKit asks that unmodified copies not be resold or claimed as one's own; this library mirrors unmodified copies publicly, so all KayKit assets are withdrawn and the source is closed to future intake.
